Finally, the review discusses key barriers to clinical translation such as limited blood-brain barrier permeability, unintended drug effects, and altered pharmacokinetics in the elderly and considers emerging technologies, including nanocarrier drug-delivery systems and AI-guided personalized treatment plans, as potential tools for achieving more precise prevention and management of POCD.
authors: Zhang A, Zhao A, Fan G, He L, Qi S.
screening_reason: Focuses on mitochondrial dysfunction triggering neuroinflammation and cell death pathways in postoperative cognitive dysfunction.
summary_ja: 本論文は、術後認知機能障害（POCD）の発生におけるミトコンドリア機能障害の役割と治療ターゲットに関する研究動向を網羅的にまとめたレビューである。ミトコンドリアのエネルギー代謝障害、活性酸素の過剰産生、カルシウム不平衡、品質管理の異常が神経炎症や細胞死経路を引き起こすメカニズムを解説している。また、SS-31、Mdivi-1、P110、NLRP3阻害剤などのミトコンドリアを標的とした薬剤の前臨床研究成果や、多標的併用療法、時間特異的介入について議論している。臨床応用に向けては、血液脳関門透過性や高齢者における薬物動態の変化などの課題があり、ナノキャリアドラッグデリバリーやAIガイド下精密医療の重要性が提起されている。
summary_en: This review outlines the pathological role of mitochondrial dysfunction, which triggers neuroinflammation and cell death in postoperative cognitive dysfunction (POCD). Preclinical mitochondrial-targeted therapies, such as SS-31 and NLRP3 inhibitors, show neuroprotective effects, but clinical translation faces challenges like blood-brain barrier permeability. Emerging approaches including nanocarriers and AI-guided personalized medicine are discussed to address these translational hurdles.
key_finding_ja: ミトコンドリアの機能障害が神経炎症と細胞死を誘発してPOCDを引き起こすメカニズムと、それを標的とする薬物療法の前臨床的有効性が示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 高齢手術患者におけるPOCDの精密な予防および治療法の開発につながる可能性がある。

title: Kinetic and inhibitory profiling of serum MMP-9 in acute spinal cord injury: neurochemical links to injury severity and neuroinflammation.
abstract: Background Spinal cord injury (SCI) is a devastating neurological condition characterized by pronounced neuroinflammation and progressive neurodegeneration. Matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9) has emerged as a crucial regulator of inflammatory cascades, yet its role as a predictive biomarker and enzyme kinetic behaviour persists ambiguous. MMP-9 has recently become a key and seemingly distinct contributor to brain physiology and pathology. The local and time-constrained nature of MMP-9 actions may be the reason why it is so specific, even when it is released into the brain by cells of different types, such as neurons, glia, and leukocytes. Objectives The aims of the study were to examine the enzymatic kinetics of MMP-9 in acute spinal cord injury, determine how MMP-9-inhibitor-I inhibits MMP-9, and correlate MMP-9 levels with the severity of injury and neuroinflammatory indicators to explore the inhibitory response of MMP-9 inhibitor-I in vitro and evaluate the potential relevance of MMP-9 as a severity-associated biomarker and experimental inhibitory target in acute SCI. Methods In this cross-sectional study, 160 patients with confirmed acute SCI were stratified according to the American Spinal Injury Association Impairment Scale into Mild/Moderate and severe groups. Serum concentrations of MMP-9, C-reactive protein (CRP), creatine kinase-BB (CK-BB), and routine biochemical markers were quantified. Multivariable regression analyses were performed to adjust for confounding variables, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis was used to assess the discriminatory performance of MMP-9. Results MMP-9 levels were significantly elevated in patients with severe SCI compared with Mild/Moderate injury (p < 0.001) and showed a strong positive correlation with injury severity (r = 0.755, p < 0.001) and positive correlation with CK-BB levels (r = 0.223, p = 0.047). MMP-9 remained independently associated with SCI severity in the adjusted model. ROC analysis demonstrated excellent discriminatory performance (AUC = 0.942; 95% CI: 0.878-1.000). Enzymatic kinetic analysis suggested higher apparent catalytic activity in severe cases, Inhibition studies showed a kinetic pattern consistent with non-competitive inhibition by MMP-9 inhibitor-I.
authors: Alburhan M, Suhail OK, Imran AH, Fadhil MM.
screening_reason: The study examines serum MMP-9 enzyme kinetics and its relationship with neuroinflammation and injury severity in spinal cord injury patients.
summary_ja: 急性脊髄損傷（SCI）患者160名を対象に、血清MMP-9濃度および酵素キネティクスと損傷重症度・神経炎症との関連を調べた横断研究です。重症SCI患者群では軽度/中等度群と比較して血清MMP-9値が有意に高値を示し、損傷重症度およびCK-BB値と強い正の相関を示しました。ROC解析においてMMP-9は重症度判別で優れた性能を示し、多重回帰分析でも独立した関連が維持されました。また、インビトロ阻害実験では、MMP-9インヒビターIによる非拮抗阻害のキネティクスパターンが確認されました。
summary_en: This cross-sectional study evaluated serum MMP-9 levels, enzymatic kinetics, and inhibition dynamics in 160 patients with acute spinal cord injury (SCI). Serum MMP-9 was significantly elevated in severe SCI patients compared to mild/moderate cases and strongly correlated with injury severity and CK-BB levels. Receiver operating characteristic analysis demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy for MMP-9 in discriminating severe injury, while in vitro assays characterized non-competitive inhibition by MMP-9 inhibitor-I.
key_finding_ja: 急性脊髄損傷患者において、血清MMP-9レベルが損傷の重症度と強く相関し、優れた重症度判定バイオマーカー候補であることが示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 急性脊髄損傷の病態把握や診断精度向上のためのバイオマーカー開発、およびMMP-9を標的とした治療戦略の立案につながる可能性があります。

title: Isopropoxate Exerts Neurotoxicity by Crossing the Blood-Brain Barrier and Mediating through Inflammation-Neurotransmitter Signaling Pathways.
abstract: Isopropoxate (IPPO), an emerging imidazole ester-type new psychoactive substance, poses potential risks to public health and the environment, yet its neurotoxic mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this study, 8-week-old C57BL/6J mice were used to evaluate the effects of IPPO on the blood-brain barrier (BBB), oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and neurotransmitter receptor systems through UPLC-MS/MS-based tissue distribution analysis, quantitative real-time PCR, TUNEL staining, and molecular docking. At a dose of 3mg/kg, IPPO accumulated in brain tissue and induced cerebral edema. Marked reductions in the tight-junction proteins Occludin and Claudin-5, together with decreased expression of the efflux transporter genes Abcb1a and Abcb1b, indicated impairment of blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity. In brain tissue, malondialdehyde (MDA) increased by approximately 30%, catalase (CAT) activity decreased by approximately 20%, and glutathione (GSH) content declined by approximately 8%, demonstrating enhanced lipid peroxidation (LPO) and weakened antioxidant defenses. IPPO exposure also upregulated components of the NLRP3 inflammasome and the pro-inflammatory mediators IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF, while reducing the anti-inflammatory cytokine IL-10 by approximately 26%, indicating disruption of the pro-/anti-inflammatory balance. Within neurotransmitter systems, DRD1 and GABRA1 protein levels increased, Taar1 expression decreased, and the immediate-early genes Fos and Arc were markedly upregulated, consistent with dysregulation of dopaminergic, GABAergic, and neuronal activity-related signaling. Molecular docking further indicated stable interactions of IPPO with GABA A and DRD1 receptors, supporting a potential direct influence on neurotransmission through key receptor targets. Transcriptomic profiling corroborated suppression of tight-junction-related genes and disturbance of neurotransmitter-associated pathways. Collectively, these findings identify a coordinated neurotoxic mechanism in which IPPO disrupts the BBB, promotes oxidative stress and neuroinflammation, and alters neurotransmitter receptor signaling.

screening_reason: The study investigates Isopropoxate neurotoxicity with a primary focus on blood-brain barrier disruption and neuroinflammation induction in the brain.
summary_ja: 新規精神活性物質であるイソプロポキセート（IPPO）の神経毒性メカニズムをマウスモデルで評価した研究です。IPPO（3mg/kg）の投与により、脳組織への蓄積と脳浮腫が認められ、タイトジャンクションタンパク質および排出トランスポーター遺伝子の発現低下に伴う血液脳関門（BBB）機能障害が示されました。さらに、脂質過酸化の亢進と抗酸化酵素活性の低下に加えて、NLRP3インフラマソームおよび炎症性サイトカインの上昇が確認されました。また、DRD1やGABRA1の発現変化など、ドパミン受容体やGABA受容体を介した神経伝達系の異常も観察されました。
summary_en: This study investigated the neurotoxic mechanisms of the new psychoactive substance isopropoxate (IPPO) in a mouse model. Administration of IPPO led to brain accumulation, cerebral edema, and disruption of blood-brain barrier integrity via reduced expression of tight-junction proteins and efflux transporters. IPPO exposure also triggered lipid peroxidation, suppressed antioxidant defenses, induced NLRP3-mediated neuroinflammation, and dysregulated dopaminergic and GABAergic neurotransmission pathways.
key_finding_ja: イソプロポキセートは血液脳関門の破綻、酸化ストレスおよびNLRP3インフラマソームを介する神経炎症を引き起こし、受容体伝達系を攪乱することが示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 新興の精神活性物質が持つ多面的な神経毒性メカニズムの解明につながり、危険ドラッグの健康リスク評価や中毒予防策の策定に寄与する可能性があります。

title: miR-4508 targets PLCB2 in propofol-induced neurotoxicity in sH-SY5Y cells: role and mechanism.
abstract: Objective Propofol is a widely administered anesthetic agent given intravenously. This study investigated the function of miR-4508 within propofol-elicited neurotoxicity in SH-SY5Y cells, identified its downstream target genes, and elucidated the underlying molecular regulatory pathway. Methods Propofol neurotoxicity was modeled in SH-SY5Y cells with varying concentrations and durations. Cell viability, miR-4508, oxidative stress, and inflammatory cytokines were measured. Target prediction and dual-luciferase validation, along with miRNA inhibitor and rescue experiments, were used to elucidate the regulatory mechanism. Cognitive function and hippocampal miR-4508 expression were also preliminarily assessed in propofol-exposed mice using the Morris water maze and RT-qPCR, respectively. Results Propofol reduced SH-SY5Y cell viability and upregulated miR-4508 in a manner dependent on both concentration and time, peaking at 50 μM for 24 h. Five candidate targets were identified bioinformatically. PLCB2 was most downregulated by miR-4508 overexpression. A dual-luciferase assay verified that miR-4508 directly binds to the PLCB2 3'-UTR. A miR-4508 inhibitor attenuated propofol-induced oxidative stress and inflammation, effects reversed by PLCB2 knockdown. Preliminary in vivo observations suggested impaired learning/memory and increased hippocampal miR-4508 in propofol-treated mice, with miR-4508 inhibition showing a tendency toward reversal of these deficits, though further validation is required. Conclusions This study demonstrates that propofol upregulates miR-4508 to suppress PLCB2, driving oxidative stress and neuroinflammation. Forward and reverse rescue experiments confirm the miR-4508/PLCB2 axis as a potential therapeutic target for propofol-induced neurotoxicity.
authors: Zhan Z, Chen H, Chen J.
screening_reason: Investigates the miR-4508/PLCB2 molecular pathway driving neuroinflammation and oxidative stress in propofol neurotoxicity.
summary_ja: プロポフォール誘発性神経毒性におけるmiR-4508とPLCB2の役割およびその分子機構を解析した研究である。SH-SY5Y細胞においてプロポフォールはmiR-4508を増加させ、標的遺伝子であるPLCB2の発現を直接抑制することを確認した。miR-4508の阻害は酸化ストレスや炎症性サイトカインの上昇を抑制し、PLCB2ノックダウンによりその効果が打ち消された。
summary_en: This study investigated the molecular mechanism of propofol-induced neurotoxicity in SH-SY5Y cells and mouse models. Propofol upregulated miR-4508, which directly bound to and suppressed PLCB2, thereby enhancing oxidative stress and neuroinflammation. Inhibition of miR-4508 attenuated these toxic effects, identifying the miR-4508/PLCB2 axis as a key driver of propofol-induced neurotoxicity.
key_finding_ja: プロポフォールはmiR-4508の発現を高めてPLCB2を抑制することにより、神経細胞の酸化ストレスと神経炎症を誘導することが明らかになった。
why_it_matters_ja: プロポフォール起因の神経毒性メカニズムが解明されたことで、麻酔薬による神経障害に対する新たな治療標的の同定につながる可能性がある。

title: A Multidimensional Optimization Strategy for High-Purity Primary Rat Microglia Isolation with Preserved Functional Responsiveness.
abstract: Background Primary microglia are essential for studying neuroinflammation and microglia-mediated neuropathology. However, conventional shaking-based isolation methods often yield unstable purity, astrocytic contamination, and heterogeneous activation states. New method We developed a multidimensional optimization strategy for primary rat microglia isolation by systematically integrating three key parameters: neonatal developmental stage, culture vessel geometry, and Percoll density gradient purification. Microglial purity, identity, viability, and functional responsiveness were evaluated by flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, Western blotting, qPCR, and ELISA. Results Compared with postnatal day 7 (P7), postnatal day 3 (P3) tissue provided higher isolation efficiency, greater culture homogeneity, and reduced astrocytic contamination. Culture in 6-cm dishes improved cell adhesion and morphological consistency. Percoll density gradient purification further increased microglial purity by approximately 20-30% while maintaining acceptable cell recovery. The optimized protocol consistently yielded cultures with stable purity (80-90%), high IBA1 positivity (>90%), increased metabolic activity, and lower basal activation. Following lipopolysaccharide stimulation, purified microglia exhibited robust inflammatory responses, including increased cytokine secretion and inflammatory gene expression. Comparison with existing methods Compared with conventional shaking-based isolation, the optimized workflow improves purity, reduces contamination, enhances reproducibility, and preserves functional responsiveness without requiring specialized equipment. Conclusions This study provides a practical and reproducible strategy for improving microglial purity and experimental consistency and offers a reliable experimental platform for neuroinflammation research and mechanistic studies.
authors: Sun X, Yan D, Zhang Y, Li D, Liu M, Wang W, Lu C, Zhang Y, Yu Y, Ma Y, Guo Y, Wu M.

summary_ja: 高純度なラット一次培養ミクログリアを単離するための多次元最適化プロトコルを開発した研究である。日齢3の脳組織、6cmディッシュでの培養、Percoll密度勾配精製を組み合わせることで、従来の振盪法より再現性と純度が向上した。得られたミクログリアは80〜90%の純度と高いIBA1陽性率を示し、低い基底活性化状態とLPS刺激に対する良好な炎症反応を保持していた。
summary_en: The authors developed a multidimensional optimization strategy for isolating high-purity primary rat microglia by integrating developmental stage, culture vessel geometry, and Percoll density gradient purification. The optimized protocol consistently yields microglia with high purity and low basal activation while preserving functional inflammatory responsiveness to lipopolysaccharide. This workflow offers a practical and highly reproducible platform for neuroinflammation research without requiring specialized equipment.
key_finding_ja: 発生段階、培養容器形状、密度勾配精製を最適化することで、高い純度と応答性を維持したラット一次培養ミクログリアの簡便な単離法を確立した。
why_it_matters_ja: 神経炎症やミクログリアが関与する神経病理の研究において、再現性の高い実験プラットフォームを提供することが期待される。
